payoutCycle.description: Payouts can be requested bi-weekly once the minimum trading days and profit targets are met.

warnings: Breaching daily or maximum drawdown limits will result in account termination.
Using prohibited trading strategies like latency arbitrage or high-frequency trading is strictly forbidden.
Payouts may be delayed if identity verification (KYC) is incomplete.

faqs.question: How does the drawdown limit work at The Trading Pit?
faqs.answer: The Trading Pit uses a trailing drawdown model based on the highest recorded account balance. If your account equity drops below the specified drawdown limit, it constitutes a breach, and the account will be closed.

seo.title: How Drawdown Works | The Trading Pit
seo.metaDescription: Learn about the trailing drawdown rules and limits at The Trading Pit to keep your account active.

faqs.question: When can I request my first payout?
faqs.answer: You can request your first payout after completing the minimum trading days requirement and achieving the profit target on your funded account, typically within 14 days of your first trade.

seo.title: When Can I Request a Payout? | The Trading Pit
seo.metaDescription: Find out the timeline and requirements for requesting your first payout with The Trading Pit.

faqs.question: What payout methods are supported by The Trading Pit?
faqs.answer: The Trading Pit supports multiple payout methods including Bank Wire Transfer, Rise, and Crypto (USDT) to ensure fast and secure withdrawals for global traders.

seo.title: Supported Payout Methods | The Trading Pit
seo.metaDescription: Explore the withdrawal options available at The Trading Pit, including Rise, Crypto, and Bank Wire.

faqs.question: Is the challenge fee refunded upon passing?
faqs.answer: Yes, the registration fee for the challenge is fully refunded to the trader along with their first successful payout from the funded account.

seo.title: Is the Challenge Fee Refundable? | The Trading Pit
seo.metaDescription: Learn about the refund policy for challenge fees on your first payout at The Trading Pit.

pros: Up to 90% profit split with scaling
cons: Challenge fees are non-refundable if the challenge is failed
